_model_note: Main session = ORCHESTRATOR on Opus 4.8 — it drives the active design stage, authors the inventory/design notes, and dispatches specialists. Subagents override via their own model: frontmatter. Reasoning-heavy nodes (spec-consistency-auditor, cto-reviewer) run on Opus 4.8 xhigh; reference-scout runs Opus 4.8 high (faithful code-contract extraction); cross-model-reviewer is a cheap Sonnet 5 driver for the Codex call. Pin exact IDs for reproducibility: claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-5. NOTE: the `sonnet` alias resolves to Sonnet 5 (claude-sonnet-5) since v2.1.197, so a `model: sonnet` node runs on Sonnet 5; pin claude-sonnet-4-6 only if you need the prior Sonnet.
_effort_note: Main session (orchestrator) runs at xhigh — Opus 4.8 supports it. Locking implementation contracts is the highest-ROI reasoning in the whole rewrite, so the author runs at max effort. Subagents set their own effort in frontmatter and override this default.
_view_note: 멀티 서브에이전트 dispatch이지만 --dangerously-skip-permissions가 dispatched bg session으로 전파되는 P0 위험을 피하려고 Agent View를 끈다. 정책상 필요하면 해제.
_plugins_note: claude-mem은 PostToolUse matcher '*'로 모든 도구 호출마다 프로세스를 띄운다. 다회 fan-out에서는 끈다(전역·타 프로젝트 영향 없음). perf-audit 2026-06-05 항목 2.
_permissions_note: This is a READ-ONLY design phase: no product code is built, no DB is touched. Bash is limited to read/search/inspect (ls/cat/rg/grep/find/tree/wc, git read commands, python for scratch counting/diffing) plus git add/commit for committing design notes per part (dev_plan 커밋 규약). psql/pg_dump denied — the design produces schema *design*, never runs DDL. git push denied (human checkpoint). The legacy-repo + design-doc immutability boundary is write-scope.sh, not permissions.
_hooks_note: Two hooks only, by policy: guardrails.sh (SessionStart — active stage objective + anti-drift/anti-hallucination hard rules; runs once, no per-tool cost) and write-scope.sh (PreToolUse — blocks writes under TRADING_SYSTEM_DIR, CRYPTO_DATA_HUB_DIR, and DESIGN_DOC_DIR (immutable inputs) and real .env files; only OUTPUT_DIR + the harness's own .claude/ are writable). No test-gate hook — this phase produces no code to test.
